items.title: Scan comments for commit-hash citations that are not ancestors of main and replace them with story/item references
items.context: Scanner: hex tokens of 7-10 chars in // and /* */ comments under packages/, verified with git cat-file -t and git merge-base --is-ancestor. Known: story-query.ts:650 (288d359377), gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke.ts:74,120,233,352 (d93b69b8f). Add a residue check (scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-residue.mjs style) that fails on any new hash citation in a comment.
